name: ePub Generator: Book Integration
description: Assembles core Book outlines into multi-chapter ePub ebooks with configurable metadata field mapping.
project_description: Book Integration is the flagship submodule of ePub Generator. It walks a core Book outline via the Book manager, renders each published child node, and assembles the tree into a single multi-chapter ePub with a hierarchical table of contents. Publishing metadata -- author, ISBN, publisher, cover image, subtitle, edition, rights, description, layout, viewport, spread, orientation -- is read from fields on the book's root node through a configurable, per-content-type field mapping. A one-click action on the field-mapping form creates and maps the full canonical field set on any content type, so a new site is one click away from complete publishing metadata. Requires the base ePub Generator module and the Book module (contrib in Drupal 11).
